name: Yagasaki Fumihiro
source:
A man from the Kansai region who wears fashionable red glasses. Works as a programmer.
He has a clear mind, but he can be very nervous and fussy.
Usually friendly and takes good care of others, but sometimes that's not the case when he's with Konno.
Easy-going, but sometimes behaves like he's better than anyone else.
